data_fields.name: frameSkipCap
data_fields.donor_constant: code default 8; option default 0; loop runs cap+1 steps

data_fields.name: stallResyncRule
data_fields.donor_constant: resync on any lag (donor); sketch resyncs only after a full missed interval

best_idea: A fixed-step client timer that advances its schedule by one interval per step, caps the catch-up, and resyncs only after a full stall, plus a layer cull that skips everything under the topmost full-screen layer.
decision_why: The capped catch-up and stall resync suit client animation on phones (a backgrounded tab must not replay an attack in one burst); the donor's off-by-one, resync-on-any-lag and integer clock are fixed in the sketch, and the frame limiter is dropped because requestAnimationFrame already paces frames.
acceptance: In a client unit test, after a 2 s stall a hero animation with cap 0 advances exactly one 100 ms step and its schedule resyncs to now; with the Pit full-screen layer up, the zone layer's draw is not called (counter reads 0 that frame).
